item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect lows from the upper forties to near fifty with cloudy or mostly cloudy skies and only a slight chance of rain showers in some areas. Monday brings highs in the upper fifties to around sixty, mostly cloudy or partly sunny skies, and a small chance of early morning rain showers. Monday night turns partly cloudy with lows falling sharply into the upper twenties to lower thirties and no precipitation expected.
